sections.title: Morning Shift (07:40 – 14:20)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
On standby to recharge the Ops Phone before commencing routes.
Ops Phone standing at 57%. Commencing Alpha Route. Patrolling down Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible.
Welfare check on Starbucks, all clear.
Welfare check along Dunkin Donuts, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Wyndham and Queen Street, checked into Hollywood Cafe, and area has been thoroughly checked, no issues found.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Shortland Street, all clear.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks completed with no issues found.

Welfare check inside McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Arrived at check in Commercial Bay. Full walkthrough completed around the area making sure no issues are present. Checked into all stores within the area, all clear.
Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls.
Continuing our patrols due to no activities concerning our assistance.
Welfare check on OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Welfare check along Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths, all clear.
Arrived at check in Corner of Customs and Albert Street Intersection, area has been thoroughly cleared, no issues.
Welfare check along Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear.

Response call from Spec Savers, reported a female who attempted theft; 2 glasses fell out of her pockets as she was trying to run away. Photo description will be provided after they've reviewed the CCTV footage.

Arrived at response location, spoke with the store staff regarding her whereabouts, last seen heading up Queen Street near Farmers. We will be keeping our presence in Queen Street and scoping the area while staying alert for other stores that may run into issues concerning the same individual.
Unable to find any POI matching the description given. Now continuing our patrols to next check point.
Welfare check inside Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, all clear.
Welfare check along Formery, Little Albert's Coffee, The People's Barista, Pizza Hut, all clear.
Arrived at check in Top of Victoria Street, welfare checks commenced along all stores within the area, all clear. Standing by to show our presence and waiting on further response calls to arise.
Continuing our patrols due to no activities concerning our assistance.
Welfare check along AA Insurance, City Convenience Plus and Mr Barbers, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Albert and Wellesley Street intersection, no issues found.

Arrived at check in Aotea Square, full sweep completed within the location, checked into Aotea Center and Jack's Fried Chicken, all clear. Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls.
Continuing our patrols. Ending Alpha Route. Commencing Echo Route now.
Walkthrough along Grey's Ave, no issues.
Arrived at check in Top of Mayoral Drive, no issues found. Checked into all stores within the location, all clear. Quick standby to show our presence.
Welfare check along Airedale Suites, all clear.
Welfare check along Queens Food Court, no issues.
Welfare check along Munster Inn and Nandos, all clear.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Response call from Management regarding a check-up at Vinka Design regarding street vagrants wandering inside their building and being a public nuisance inside and outside their building entrance.

Response call from Spec Savers, reported an update about the individual who stole this morning. There were 3 glasses in total taken off the shelf; 2 were dropped and retrieved, but one was taken with her as she left the store.
Guard is splitting up to retrieve a photo/video of the POI.
Meeting at Vinka Design occurring and on standby for further response calls.

Second guard has found a female POI who matches the description of the theft that occurred at Spec Savers. After a little verbal altercation, the POI agreed to a bag check. Was unable to find any of the items listed from Spec Savers. Advised the POI that the cameras and CCTV footage are watching her if she does try to steal again.
Meeting completed at Vinka Design, now continuing our patrols and regrouping with second guard.
Team has now regrouped and continuing our patrols. Patrolling down High Street commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses along the way.
Welfare check along Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall, all clear.
Arrived at check in Chancery Square, full sweep within the vicinity, no issues found. Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls.
Continuing our patrols due to no activities concerning our assistance.
Welfare check commenced along O'Connell Lane and Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Arrived at check in Wilson's Carpark Fort Street, checked in on static guards and stores within the area, all clear.
Arrived at check in Bottom of Fort Street, checked into all stores and businesses within the area, all clear. Standby for response calls while showing our presence.
Continuing our patrols due to no issues visible.
Arrived at check in Kiwi Bank, welfare checks completed on all stores nearby.
Arrived at check in Commercial Bay, full scope of the location, checked into Adidas and McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Response call from Canterbury Arcade, reported an elderly male seeking assistance to a location. Unable to speak English but has an address with him (photo/video on file).
Arrived at response location, now assisting the individual to their location.

We have successfully dropped off the individual to his location. The staff has now taken him in to assist him. Location: Auckland Community Law Centre, Level 2, 16-22 Anzac Avenue. Now on route to HQ for break and changeover to the Afternoon shift.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street, reported a male street vagrant sleeping inside the store. Requesting assistance to wake him up and move him along.
Off duty Guard (Brent) was seen nearby; the store manager waved him down to assist in removing the POI.
Arrived at HQ, taking our short break before changing over to the Afternoon shift.

End of shift note: Male individual with short curly hair, shoulder high, wearing black shirt, navy blue and greyish jeans with black slide-on shoes. Please keep an eye out and be on alert for this individual, could possibly steal again.
Street vagrants need to be issued a trespass notice if asked to move from a certain area multiple times. If no action is taken they will keep returning once they leave.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:35 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Commencing patrols, standing by at the corner of Victoria St East / Queen St for any nearby response calls or problematic issues/vagrants within the area.

Response call from Peter Alexander regarding a male that has just run out of their store with their items, last seen heading up Queen St. Whilst on standby managed to spot male vagrant from Peter Alexander (well known thief within the CBD).
Approached male vagrant and asked if we could search him; he complied but got aggressive verbally. Standing by.
Search complete, no items from Peter Alexander were found on him; he informed us that he had left it at the store. Heading back to Peter Alexander.
Arrived at Peter Alexander Queen St, informed staff member that he had no items on him and that he had left the items in the store.
Maintaining our presence along Queen St for any nearby response calls or problematic issues or vagrants; welfare checks on stores whilst doing so.
Arrived at Pocket Park, welfare checks on stores along lower Queen St, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for any problematic issues as well as maintaining a heavy security presence.
Leaving standby area, no issues have occurred.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Welfare check:
All clear, no issues to report.
Commercial Bay sweep complete, no issues to report.
Arrived at lower Albert St check in. Welfare check:
All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Albert Mart check in, all clear, no issues to report.
St Patricks Sq sweep complete, no issues to report.
Arrived at the corner of Wyndham St / Albert St. Welfare check:
All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at the corner of Albert St / Victoria St West. Welfare check:
All clear, no issues to report.

Response call from Mountain Warehouse regarding a suspicious male inside their store who has been inside the fitting room for some time; asked for assistance and for us to standby in case he commits a theft.
Arrived at Mountain Warehouse, POI has already left the store and has committed theft, last seen heading up Vulcan Lane.

Arrived at Vulcan Lane, no sign of male POI; informed manager that we will keep an eye out for him whilst on patrols and if found we will retrieve stolen items (photo on file). Description: black Adidas pants (red stripes), white earphones, black jacket. Standing by.
Whilst on standby we noticed the well known thief from Peter Alexander earlier on walking along Queen St; shadowing him from afar in case he decides to steal again.
Arrived at the top of Wellesley St West; male individual we shadowed has gone towards Hobson St.
Aotea Sq sweep complete, no issues to report.
Arrived at Queens Court. Welfare check:
All clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Auckland Library complete, no issues to report.
Lorne St sweep complete as well as welfare checks on stores, no issues to report.
Maintaining our presence along Queen St. Standing by outside of Footlocker.
Whilst on standby, Footlocker staff member signalled out to us to help with removing a female and male individual from the store as they were refusing to leave after making a mess inside their store.
Female and male individuals have left the store with no issues to report as she was compliant. Standing by.

Whilst standing by outside of Footlocker, noticed some vagrants sitting outside of Localito; as informed by the morning shift they are no longer allowed to sit outside their store or premises. Informed them to move along and they complied, no issues to report. Standing by (photo on file).
Arrived at Darby St check in. Welfare check:

Arrived at the top of Victoria St West, welfare check in on stores that are still open, all clear, none of the stores have anything to report. Standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants that may occur within the area.
Leaving standby area, no issues have occurred.
Arrived at Wyndham St check in. Welfare check:
All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham St. Welfare check:
None have anything to report. Standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving standby area, no issues have occurred.
Arrived at Commercial Bay, welfare check in McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants that may occur within the area.
No issues have occurred within the area, leaving standby area.
Arrived at Gore St check in, commencing full sweep down to Pocket Park, welfare checks on stores whilst doing so.

Arrived at Pocket Park. Full sweep of Fort St, Commerce St, Gore St complete, no issues to report, as well as welfare checks on stores, none have anything to report. Standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants that may pop up within the area.
Leaving standby area, no issues have occurred.
Arrived at High St check in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Freyburg Sq / Chancery Sq. Sweep complete, no issues to report. Standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Response call from McDonald's Queen St regarding a male individual that is screaming inside their store; asked for assistance in removing him from the premises.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen St; manager informed us that she doesn't know which individual it was. Standing by as she grabs the footage.
Footage received; male that we came for has already left the store. Standing by in case he decides to return.
Arrived back at HQ for 30 min meal break.
Standing by HQ awaiting night shift as well as being vigilant to any response calls we may receive.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. Auror reports have been processed.
